review_candidates.description: Chief of Staff (Electrical Engineering) Lisbon, Portugal Department: Management Employment Type: Permanent Contract with 6-month probation period Minimum Experience: Executive Level We are looking for an accomplished Chief of Staff to work directly with the CEO, providing strategic, operational, commercial, and technical support across the company's operations in Norway, Finland, and Portugal. This is a senior leadership position for an experienced electrical engineering professional who can bridge technical expertise and business strategy, coordinate C-suite priorities, drive strategic initiatives, and ensure effective execution of executive decisions. Working closely with the CFO, COO, CCO, CIO, and other executives, the Chief of Staff will prepare executive decision-making materials, coordinate cross-functional priorities, manage the executive meeting rhythm, and support communication with the Board and parent group, CTS Group. Key Responsibilities CEO Support and Executive Office Act as the CEO's principal adviser and sounding board on business, operational, and technical matters. Manage the CEO's priorities, agenda, and time allocation, acting as a filter and escalation point for issues requiring CEO attention. Prepare briefings, analysis, presentations, and recommendations for CEO meetings, client meetings, and key decisions. Follow up on CEO commitments and requests, ensuring timely completion across the organisation. Represent the CEO in internal and external meetings when required, ensuring alignment and follow-up. C-Suite Coordination and Executive Meetings Coordinate communication between the CEO and C-suite executives, including the CFO, COO, CCO, and CIO. Manage weekly executive meetings, quarterly business reviews, and strategy sessions. Set agendas, prepare pre-reading materials, record decisions, and track executive actions through completion. Ensure alignment across functions on shared priorities and resolve or escalate cross-functional issues. Coordinate executive input for Board meetings and CTS Group reporting with the CFO and functional leaders. Strategy and Business Planning Support the CEO in defining, communicating, and cascading company strategy and annual objectives. Coordinate annual business planning and budgeting with the CFO and executive team. Analyse strategic opportunities, including market entry, growth options, partnerships, and emerging technologies such as renewables and BESS grid connections. Provide engineering insight into strategic decisions, including technical and execution risks associated with major bids and projects. Monitor progress against strategic objectives and identify risks, gaps, and corrective actions. Develop new processes and procedures and improve existing ones using AI and emerging technologies, ensuring stakeholder engagement, implementation, and ongoing maintenance. Strategic Initiatives and Performance Reporting Lead or coordinate high-priority, cross-functional initiatives on behalf of the CEO, from planning through delivery. Develop and maintain company-level KPI dashboards covering commercial, operational, financial, and HSE performance. Track the order book, sales pipeline, and key project performance in collaboration with Bid & Sales, Finance, and Project Delivery. Prepare business cases and ad hoc analysis to support executive decisions. Align DCS Norway processes and reporting with CTS Group requirements. Work with the CEO to develop AI-enabled reporting structures and metrics for tracking strategic initiatives and business performance. Technical Advisory and Governance Act as the CEO's technical adviser, reviewing the technical basis, assumptions, and risks of major bids, projects, and investment decisions. Participate in or lead technical reviews with Engineering and Project Delivery, highlighting technical and execution issues. Support technical discussions with clients, grid owners such as Statnett and Fingrid, partners, and key suppliers. Assess new technologies, standards, and regulatory changes, including grid codes and NEK 440 / FEF updates. Maintain the corporate governance framework, including delegations of authority and executive approval processes. Act as a point of contact for the Board and parent group on behalf of the CEO. Demonstrate a strong interest in AI and automation, with strong knowledge and practical skills using Claude (mandatory) . Experience with other AI tools is an advantage. Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, specialising in Power Systems or a related discipline, is required. Senior professional engineering registration, such as Ordem dos Engenheiros – Membro Sénior or equivalent, is an advantage. An MBA or postgraduate business qualification is an advantage. Professional Experience Minimum 15 years of professional experience as an electrical engineer, including at least 10 years in the power, energy infrastructure, or EPC sector, ideally involving MV/HV substation projects. At least 5 years in a senior leadership role, such as Engineering Manager, Technical Director, Project Director, or equivalent. Proven experience working directly with CEOs, executive teams, and Boards, influencing decisions at executive level. In-depth, hands-on understanding of the complete EPC project lifecycle, including tendering, engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning. Experience leading complex, high-value projects or programmes and cross-functional initiatives in a growing or multi-country organisation. Experience preparing Board-level reports and working with parent companies or investors. Technical and Business Skills Senior-level electrical engineering expertise in MV/HV substations and power systems, with the technical authority to engage with design, bid, and project teams, clients, and grid owners. Familiarity with power-sector standards and regulations, including IEC 61936-1, IEC 62271, NEK 440, FEF, and SFS 6001. Understanding of project controls, technical and commercial risks, and the cost and margin drivers of EPC contracts. Strong strategic, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex issues and recommend clear actions. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with BI and dashboard tools such as Power BI is an advantage. Solid understanding of business planning, budgeting, financial statements, and project-based business models. Programme and project management skills, including planning, risk management, and governance. Understanding of corporate governance, internal controls, and compliance across multiple jurisdictions. Interpersonal and Communication Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Portuguese is an advantage. Must have the right to work in the EU/EEA and be available to travel to Norway and Finland as required. Strong organisational and multitasking capabilities. Highest level of discretion, integrity, and professionalism when handling confidential information. Ability to influence without direct authority and build trust with the CEO and C-suite executives. Clear and structured communication skills, translating complex technical and commercial information into concise executive briefings. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment while managing multiple high-priority topics. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Delivery of strategic initiatives on time and against agreed objectives. Timely preparation and quality of executive and Board materials. Closure rate of CEO and executive actions within agreed deadlines. Availability and accuracy of company KPI dashboards and management reporting. CEO and C-suite feedback on the effectiveness of executive coordination and support. Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Comply with applicable health, safety, and environmental legislation, regulations, and company procedures. Integrate safety-by-design principles into engineering and project activities, prioritising personnel, equipment, and environmental safety. Participate in relevant risk assessments and hazard identification activities. Report safety concerns, incidents, and near-misses in accordance with company HSE procedures. Promote and maintain a positive safety culture within the team and across projects. Ensure compliance with the company's Integrated Management System (IMS), covering quality, safety, and environmental standards. Replacement Policy For absences of less than one month, the Chief of Staff will be replaced by the Chief Executive Officer. For absences exceeding one-month, senior management will appoint a temporary replacement. Internal or external recruitment may apply in accordance with DCS Norway replacement policy guidelines. The replacement will assume the key responsibilities outlined in the job description to ensure continuity in executive coordination and strategic initiatives. Compensation and Benefits Annual variable performance bonus of 0–10% , subject to company and individual performance and an annual performance review. Meal allowance of €10.46 per working day , provided via a meal card. Private health insurance coverage for the employee. 22 working days of annual leave , in accordance with Portuguese labour law. For business travel outside Portugal, a nominal Portugal allowance of approximately €89 per day , with 50% payment for the final travel day. The company will cover accommodation and travel costs for approved business trips, as reflected in the employment contract. When the daily living-away allowance is paid, the meal card allowance is not payable.

Leadership Lead and mentor the infrastructure modelling team, providing day-to-day technical guidance and support. Develop and deliver training on BIM standards, tools, and workflows. Lead coordination meetings and model review sessions across disciplines. Qualifications Minimum of 10 years of professional experience, with proven expertise in delivering infrastructure projects using BIM in accordance with ISO 19650 standards. Advanced knowledge of Civil 3D and Navisworks. Strong expertise in ACC and understanding of its processes. Proficient in Dynamo for Civil 3D, including developing scripts for automation and process improvements. Proven ability to lead coordination meetings, manage interdisciplinary teams, and facilitate model review sessions. Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey technical information and collaborate across teams. Additional Information Relevant Autodesk certifications (e.g., Civil 3D, Navisworks). Background in large-scale infrastructure projects, including utilities and road design.

Vei fi responsabil de desfasurarea activitatilor operationale zilnice din aria Accounts Payable (Furnizori), contribuind la raportarile financiare, situatiile financiare si eficienta operationala generala a companiei. Vei asigura acuratetea datelor, respectarea termenelor si conformitatea proceselor, inclusiv pentru verificarea si inregistrarea facturilor, efectuarea platilor si gestionarea cheltuielilor. Iti vei asuma responsabilitatea pentru activitatile tale, vei identifica probleme si vei cauta proactiv solutii impreuna cu managerul direct. Responsabilitati principale Arie de responsabilitate si impact • Procesezi in mod autonom, corect si la timp tranzactiile financiare din zona de Accounts Payable: - verificarea si inregistrarea facturilor; - plati recurente; - self-billing (autofacturare); - emiterea notelor de debit; - gestionarea cheltuielilor (expense management). • Asiguri desfasurarea proceselor financiare conform procedurilor stabilite. • Solutionezi problemele operationale din aria ta de responsabilitate si escaladezi catre manager subiectele mai complexe. • Te asiguri ca sarcinile sunt finalizate integral si la timp. • Mentin o abordare orientata catre client si calitatea serviciilor oferite. Comunicare si colaborare • Comunici clar si profesionist cu colegii si partile interesate interne. • Participi activ la sedinte si prezinti subiecte din aria ta de expertiza. • Iti sustii recomandarile si concluziile cu date si exemple concrete. Imbunatatire procese • Identifici si rezolvi probleme operationale din procesele gestionate. • Documentezi activitatile si procedurile de lucru. • Colaborezi cu echipa pentru optimizarea proceselor si cresterea calitatii serviciilor. review_candidates.title: Accountmanager Noord-Holland
review_candidates.description: Alle ruimte voor jouw drive Ben jij de commerciële topper die in de regio Noord-Holland het verschil maakt? Bij Euromaster zoeken we een gedreven Accountmanager die onze zakelijke klanten naar een hoger niveau tilt. In deze rol ben jij de spil die commerciële kansen omzet in langdurige relaties. Jouw energie, onze kracht! Over Euromaster Als dochteronderneming van Michelin zijn we een van de grootste Europese bedrijven voor banden en services. Alleen al in Nederland zijn we aanwezig met meer dan tachtig vestigingen. Waar je ook aan de slag gaat, je komt terecht in een hecht team met de informele familiecultuur van een klein bedrijf, maar wel met de zekerheid en het perspectief van een grote organisatie. En dat biedt dan weer volop mogelijkheden voor je eigen loopbaan. Want bij Euromaster heeft iedereen gelijke kansen. Aan jou om ze te grijpen!  Wat ga je doen als Accountmanager? In deze uitdagende rol krijg je alle ruimte voor jouw ambitie. Als Accountmanager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de realisatie van de commerciële doelstellingen voor de vestigingen in de regio Noord-Holland. Je bent de volwaardige B2B-gesprekspartner voor fleetowners, transporteurs en industrie klanten. Netwerk bouwen: Je onderhoudt uitstekende contacten met bestaande klanten en weet nieuwe klanten aan ons te binden. Service als product: Je inventariseert wensen en vertaalt deze naar slimme mobiliteitsoplossingen. Je adviseert over de optimale bandenkeuze en total cost of ownership. Strategie: Je stelt een verkoop- en service-jaarplan op en werkt nauw samen met onze vestigingen om een uitmuntende dienstverlening te garanderen. Conceptverkoop: Het verkopen van onze totaaloplossingen is jou op het lijf geschreven. Je rapporteert in deze functie rechtstreeks aan de Sales Manager.. Ben jij de Accountmanager die we zoeken? Om van deze functie een succes te maken, herken jij jezelf in het volgende profiel: Niveau & ervaring: HBO werk- en denkniveau en enkele jaren relevante commerciële B2B-buitendienst ervaring. Affiniteit: Kennis van of ervaring in de transportwereld en techniek is een grote pré. Mindset: Je bent een leergierige, creatieve, doortastende en ondernemende teamplayer. Communicatie: Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen verschillende niveaus en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Hands-on: Je bent omgevingsbewust, flexibel en kunt uitstekend uit de voeten met moderne ICT-programma’s. Wat mag je van Euromaster verwachten? Werken bij Euromaster betekent impact maken bij het leukste bedrijf in de automotive branche, met een hecht team en een informele sfeer. Jouw inzet verdient een passende beloning: Salaris: Een basissalaris tussen € 3.200,- en € 4.500,- bruto per maand o.b.v. 38 uur, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en kennis. Mobiliteit: Een representatieve leaseauto voor jouw werkzaamheden in de regio. Verlof & balans: 27 verlofdagen (20 wettelijke en 7 bovenwettelijke dagen), plus extra verlofdagen bij een leeftijd ouder dan 45 jaar. Als fulltime medewerker werk je 40 uur en krijg je daarnaast minimaal 12 ATV-dagen per jaar. Bonus: Een aantrekkelijke individuele bonusregeling. Kortingen: Personeelskorting op banden en auto-onderhoud én personeelskorting via Benefits@work. Ontwikkeling: In het kader van jouw ontwikkeling bespreek je regelmatig jouw ambities en doelen. Aandelen: Jaarlijks de mogelijkheid tot aanschaf van Michelin-aandelen tegen aantrekkelijke voorwaarden. Veiligheid voorop: Wat we ook doen, veiligheid staat voorop. Dit geldt voor onze mensen, onze klanten en onze werkwijze op de weg. Overtuigd? Solliciteer direct! Ben jij de gedreven Accountmanager die Noord-Holland gaat veroveren? Klik op de solliciteer-button en wie weet verwelkomen we je binnenkort in het team. Heb je nog vragen voordat je solliciteert? Neem gerust contact op met de afdeling HRM via hrm.nl@euromaster.com

review_candidates.description: Senegal 23374 Regional Community Stabilisation Officer (2) Organization International Organization for Migration Posted 21 Oct 2026 Closing date 3 Nov 2026 Assisted Voluntary Return and Reintegration (AVRR) is one of the core areas of IOM expertise, and a field in which the organization has over 40 years of experience. The Protection (MPX) Unit within the Regional Office for West and Central Africa (WCA) is responsible for thematic oversight and technical support for all Protection, Return and Reintegration programmes implemented within the WCA Region. Together with IOM Headquarters, IOM Global Office in Washington, D.C., and IOM in respective Country Offices, RO WCA works to provide eligible beneficiaries with access to protection services, including assisted voluntary return to their countries of origin or of legal status, in a safe and dignified manner. In addition to travel arrangements, IOM’s assistance may include protection screening, counselling, acquisition of travel documents, provision of medical or other escorts, departure, transit and arrival assistance. Under the overall supervision of the Deputy Regional Director for Operations, the direct supervision of the Senior Regional Migrant Assistance Thematic Specialist and in coordination with IOM Global Office in Washington, D.C. colleagues and relevant IOM WCA Country Offices, the incumbent will have the following duties and responsibilities. In close coordination with the Regional Office and IOM Global Office in Washington, D.C., relevant Units at HQ, the IOM offices in the region, Government counterparts and other relevant public/private sector partner organizations in the geographical area of the response, contribute to drafting/reviewing protection assessments and identify risk mitigation strategies focusing on, among others, operational settings and accessibility of services, including shelter, legal frameworks, protection risks for specific vulnerable groups, key protection actors on the ground and available referral pathways, safe environments for return in countries of origin (CoOs), etc. In coordination with the MPX Regional Thematic Specialist (RTS) and IOM Global Office in Washington, D.C., provide technical guidance and support to national and international protection staff in the WCA Region to ensure high-quality outcomes for migrants, while advising on operational coordination and ensuring adherence to IOM policies. Ensure appropriate coordination in line with IOM and interagency standards. Participate in relevant coordination mechanisms or task forces at local level and/or at regional level, as relevant. Contribute to the implementation of inter-agency coordination standards and the development of context-specific guidance as relevant. Provide remote and in-person thematic support to Country Offices in the context of the setup of the response and provision of assistance, ensuring a coherent approach across all interventions. Be available for short-notice international deployments outside the duty and home station, when required, to support urgent protection responses. Represent RO WCA in technical meetings and forums, including with donors, partners, and stakeholders, as required. Identify emerging operational priorities and contribute to the design and development of project proposals and activities based on solid results frameworks, in response to emerging trends and priorities, as well as donor interests and requirements. Support the Senior Regional Migrant Assistance Specialist in case management coordination, including providing technical input to the review of complex Assisted Voluntary Return (AVR) cases and internal approval processes, in line with IOM protection policies and standards. Contribute to developing and delivering specialized training on AVR, case management, and protection interventions. Contribute to the exchange of lessons learned, best practices and tools at the regional and intra-regional level. Perform such other duties as may be assigned. Qualifications Required Qualifications and Experience Education Master’s degree in Social Sciences, International Relations/Affairs, Research, Law, or a related field from an accredited academic institution with five years of relevant professional experience; or, Bachelor’s degree in the above fields with seven years of relevant professional experience. Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experience Experience working with migrants, civil society, and governments; Experience working in multicultural and multidisciplinary teams; Proven experience supporting protection programming, as well as mainstreaming protection across operations, preferably across multiple countries; Proven experience providing protection and assistance to migrants in vulnerable situations and communicating with individuals who have complex needs; Experience working in return and reintegration programs; Experience in capacity building, training delivery, and the development of operational tools and guidance is preferred; and, Experience with IOM or other UN agencies, and specialized protection programs, is preferred. Skills Strong knowledge of IOM and inter-agency protection standards and operational procedures and guidelines; Solid coordination skills; Ability to research and adapt to different operational and cultural contexts; Strong writing, editing, presentation, and training facilitation skills; Excellent computer skills, including proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, email/internet software, and relevant statistical analysis packages; Knowledge of UN cooperation frameworks and bilateral donor programming requirements; Ability to gather, consolidate, and attribute information from multiple sources; High degree of judgment and initiative, with the ability to work independently within assigned responsibilities; Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills; and, Proven ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with people of diverse cultural and national backgrounds. Languages For this position, fluency in English and French is required (oral and written). Working knowledge of another official UN languages (Arabic, Chinese, Russian, and Spanish) is an advantage. Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments. How to apply Internationally recruited professional staff are required to be mobile. Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months. Appointment will be subject to all clearances, including medical and security, as well as accreditation, and any residency or visa requirements. Vacancies close at 23:59 local time in Geneva, Switzerland on the respective closing date. No late applications will be accepted. IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, harassment, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and any forms of discrimination. IOM is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children. IOM conducts reference checks and background verification, including through system-wide databases such as ClearCheck, to help ensure that candidates have no record of misconduct, including on sexual harassment, sexual exploitation and abuse, or fraud. Candidates are expected to uphold these standards and principles at all times. IOM does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process—whether for application, interview, processing, training, or otherwise—and does not request any information related to bank accounts. IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM WAVE system (for internal candidates, link here). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies.
